name: httpbingo
description: An HTTP testing service (a Go version of httpbin). Inspect your requests and ask for specific responses: status codes, redirects, headers, JSON and XML.

requests.name: Anything
requests.description: Accepts any method and sends back everything about the request: method, args, headers and body.

requests.name: Teapot status
requests.description: Responds with the status code at the end of the URL. 418 is "I'm a teapot".

requests.name: Random UUID
requests.description: Returns a new random UUID every time.

requests.name: Sample JSON
requests.description: A small nested JSON document. Nice for trying the expand and collapse buttons.

requests.name: Sample XML
requests.description: An XML document. Not JSON, so it shows as text.

requests.name: Get an image
requests.description: Responds with a picture instead of text. Change png to jpeg, webp or svg for other formats.

requests.name: Bearer token check
requests.description: Accepts any Bearer token. Switch the header off to see a 401.

requests.name: Set response headers
requests.description: Every query param becomes a response header. Check the response HEADERS tab.

requests.name: Follow redirects
requests.description: Redirects twice before landing on a final page. Pixapie follows redirects for you.
